translation:
Cough with qi rebelling, sore throat and hoarse voice, the pulse tight and rapid — this is lung deficiency with depletion of liver fluid; it is very difficult to handle.

Chuan Huanglian, Pipaye, Jubai, Renzhongbai, Zhimu, Chen Ejiao, Ziwan, Maidong, sheng Miren, Jizihuang (egg yolk, 雞子黃), taken raw with water.

Kidney water is unable to control fire, so it must attack metal; yin essence is unable to transform qi, so it must cause cough and dryness; therefore there is cough with qi rebelling and hoarse voice, the pulse moving without spirit — this is the appearance of wood depression and water deficiency, with deficient fire flaring upward. I propose a method of nourishing and absorbing, to observe the movement and stillness.

Qingyan stir-fried Shudi (salt-stir-fried prepared Rehmannia, 青鹽炒熟地), Muli, Chuanbei, Chuan Yujin, Yun Fushen, salt-water stir-fried Guangpi (tangerine peel, 鹽水炒廣皮), Huai Xi (Achyranthes, 淮膝), Guiban, Chuan Baihe, Jizihuang.

The evil has not been thoroughly dispersed, with hoarse voice and sore throat; the illness has not lasted long, so there is no great harm.

Xuanfuhua, Madouling, Mahuang (ephedra, 麻黃), Xiang Beimu (Fritillaria, 象貝母), Sangye, Ziwan rong, Xingren, Jiegeng, Renzhonghuang (urine sediment, 人中黃).

Follow-up formula:

Ziwan, Renzhonghuang, Niuxi, Bei Shashen, Sangye, Xingren, sheng Hake, Miren, Tianhuafen (Trichosanthes root, 天花粉).

Cough and choking with hoarse voice — middle deficiency with wood fire scorching metal.

Sheng Qi, Bei Shashen, Juhong, Niuxi, Chuan Baihe, Danpi, Maidong rou, Ziwan, Chuanbei, winter mulberry leaf.

Cough with froth and hoarse voice, middle deficiency, the lung qi not clear — one should use a light formula to soothe and regulate.

Xuanfuhua, sheng Miren, Pipaye, Dongguazi, Zhimu, Ziwan rong, stir-fried Suzi, Madouling, winter mulberry leaf, Juhong.

Cough with qi rebelling and hoarse voice, seemingly belonging to yin deficiency with fire moving; yet the pulse does not show deficiency and rapidity — one can see that the latent evil has not been thoroughly cleared. One should use a light formula to harmonize and regulate.

Fresh Shihu, sheng Hake, Maidong, Juhong, Chuan Yujin zhi (Curcuma juice), Ziwan rong, sweet Xingren, Chuanbei, Douling (Aristolochia fruit, 兜鈴), fresh Pipaye.

The upper diaphragm and the arm (shoulder) are distended, painful and insensitive, the six pulses wiry and rapid, restless whether sitting or lying — this is warm evil entering the collaterals; I fear the lung qi will be flaccid and injured; one must use a method of clearing and freeing (recently there is a little phlegm and wheezing).

Xuanfuhua, Lingyangjiao, Fa Banxia, Danggui, Baijili, Juye, Daizheshi, Chuan Yujin, stir-fried Suzi, Qinjiao, sheng Miren, Sangzhi.

The collaterals are not free and the qi is obstructed, with the right chest and ribs swollen high, the right cun and guan pulses large — I fear the lung qi will be flaccid and injured; I propose a method of freeing the collaterals and transforming phlegm, assisted by regulating qi, to seek relaxation (the phlegm is black, with a fishy smell, and a little cough).

Xuanfuhua, Pipaye, Niuxi tan, Danggui, Gougou, Sangzhi, stir-fried Suzi, Banxiaqu, Walengzi, Juye, Yujin.

Cough and choking with foul phlegm and blood, the right pulse wiry and rapid — arising from qi depression and injury to the collaterals, the lung metal being attacked; the Winter Solstice (冬至) is near; one must relax the mind and regulate.

Chen Ejiao, Danshen, Miren, Maidong rou, stir-fried Suzi, Oujie, Bei Shashen, Qiancao, Juhong, Pipaye, Huai Niuxi.

When suffering from malaria, the exterior was not properly treated, the lung qi is not diffused, with flaccidity of the shoulder and hemoptysis, prolonged without recovery, exterior deficiency with spontaneous sweating, and the complexion and spirit are pale and white — the condition belongs to lung flaccidity (肺痿); one should not overuse cooling agents (foul phlegm with great loss of blood).

Sheng Qi, Pipaye, Juhong, Hafen stir-fried Ejiao, Ouzhi (lotus root juice, 藕汁), Miren, Huai Niuxi, Qiancao, Chuan Baihe, Dongguazi.

Difficulty in swallowing food with choking and rebellion, phlegm and wheezing with stirring of blood — this is liver depression punishing metal and the lung qi being flaccid and injured. I fear the illness will be severe in the height of summer; be cautious, be cautious.

Chen Ejiao, sweet Xingren, Maidong, winter mulberry leaf, Dongguazi, Maogen, sheng Miren, Chuan Beimu, Juhong, sheng Hake, Pipaye.

The lung qi is originally deficient, and again affected by warm evil, with body heat and hemoptysis — the lung collaterals are injured. Therefore the sputum is sticky and gelatinous, the six pulses rapid and large; although the upright qi is deficient, warming and supplementing is not appropriate.

Sheng Yangshen 1.5 qian, sheng Miren 4 qian, Chuan Baihe 3 qian, Maochai gen 4 qian, Chen Ejiao 2 qian, Juhong 1 qian, Shashen 2 qian, Pipaye 1.5 qian, brushed, Qiancao 1 qian, Huai Xi tan 1.5 qian.
translator_notes: 肺痿 (fei wei) rendered as 'lung flaccidity', a classical consumptive lung condition.
寸關 (cun guan) refers to the cun and guan pulse positions; kept as 'cun and guan'.

translation:
Qi deficiency with weak exterior, the complexion and pulse lacking spirit, spontaneous sweating belonging to leakage — the proper method is to cultivate the root.

Zhi Huangqi, Fushen, Baishao, Digupi, Muli, Hongzao, Chuan Shihu, Zaoren, Xinhui, Nüzhenzi, Sangye.

The exterior and interior are both deficient, the body is emaciated and the pulse weak, the illness has lasted three years — one must supplement both qi and yin.

Zhi Huangqi, Fushen, Shanyao, Maidong rou, Danpi, Shudi, Zaoren, Wuwei, Nüzhenzi, Hongzao.

Little food and much phlegm, fire moving with insomnia; examining the six pulses they are deficient, wiry and without strength — one can see that both qi and yin are insufficient. Take strengthening the middle and protecting the lung as the main.

Xi Dangshen, Chen Ejiao, Fushen, Huai Yao (Dioscorea, 淮藥), Maidong rou, Zhi Yuzhu, Bei Shashen, Zaoren, Baihe, Jubai.

Malaria-like (類瘧) with choking and aversion to cold, soft pulse, the exterior and interior both deficient — there is no strategy other than supplementing.

Huangqi, Fushen, Maidong, Baishao, Sangye, Shouwu, Zaoren, Juhong, Muli, Hongzao.

After loss of blood, wheezing and cough have already lasted one year, qi and blood both deficient — this is by no means light or trivial.

Shudi, Bei Shashen, Fushen, Muli, Juhong, Danpi, Chen Ejiao, Zaoren, Shanyao.

Wheezing and cough with hemoptysis, aversion to cold and spontaneous sweating, rapid pulse with abdominal pain, the stools not bound — not only is the nutritive fluid internally depleted, but the liver and stomach are also defeated and exhausted; none of these are favorable conditions.

I tentatively propose a method of supplementing the earth and settling the metal, hoping to obtain effect.

Zhi Mianqi, Huai Shanyao, Fushen, Tusizi, Hafen stir-fried Ejiao, Bei Shashen, Muli, Xianglian, Pipaye.

Kidney water is unable to control fire, so it must attack metal; yin essence is unable to transform wind, so it must cause dryness; dryness then itches, itching then coughs, so that there is hoarse voice and sore throat, the pulse moving without spirit — this is the appearance of wood depression and water deficiency, with deficient fire flaring upward. I propose nourishing and absorbing, to observe the movement and stillness.

Qingyan stir-fried Shudi, Muli, Chuanbei, Chuan Yujin, Yun Fushen, salt-water stir-fried Guangpi, Huai Xi, Guiban, Chuan Baihe, Jizihuang, taken with water.

The constitution is weak and fire flares, with toothache and dry mouth, the six pulses not wiry and rapid — this is the liver and kidney being deficient and unable to transport fluids to supply upward; one should not over-administer cooling agents.

Xi Dangshen, Ejiao, Fushen, Bei Shashen, Qingyan, Da Shudi, Danpi, Zaoren, Maidong rou.

Qi deficiency with weak exterior, chills and fever at irregular times, the nutritive collaterals empty and deficient, wheezing with fire rising, the six pulses not very strong — one must attend to both qi and yin.

Zhen Xidang, Fushen, Bei Shashen, Maidong, Jubai, Zhi Yuzhu, Qizi, Huai Shanyao, Ejiao, Qingyan.

After repeatedly taking supplementing agents, there is no distension of the diaphragm or pain — not only is the nutritive fluid deficient, but the exterior yang is also not secure; it is very appropriate to use heavy doses and supplement frequently, and then it may obtain effect.

Xi Dangshen, Shudi, Fushen, Maidong, Muli, Bei Shashen, Huai Xi, Zaoren, Baihe, Shuili (pear, 水梨).

Loss of blood together with seminal emission, deficiency and damage of the liver and kidney, the sinews contracted so that sitting and lying are restless, the six pulses fine and soft without strength — this belongs to lower deficiency. And blood does not nourish the liver, with leakage and spontaneous sweating — this is a condition of great deficiency. One must use heavy doses to cultivate and supplement.

Zhi Mianqi, Fushen, Maidong, Gouji, Qizi, Da Shudi, Zaoren, Wuwei, Longchi, Yujin, taken with water.

The qi aspect is insufficient, the liver collaterals not harmonious — treat by supplementing qi and nourishing the nutritive (營) (with exertion, food decreases; when hungry, the left hypochondrium pains; the feet are numb and there is headache).

Yuzhu, Guishen, Chuanduan, Gougou, Xiangfu, Fuling, Baishao, Faxia, Qizi.

Pill formula:

Xi Dang, Guishen, Chuanduan, Fuling, Faxia, Shudi, Yuzhu, Baishao, Tusizi, Muxiang, Xinhui, Zhi Cao.

The lung and kidney are both deficient, with lumbar pain and phlegm and wheezing, limited food and drink — one should supplement the spleen and kidney and protect the lung, and regulate.

Zhi Qi, Yuzhu, Wuwei, Qizi, Shayuan, Wuzhigu (cuttlefish bone, 烏賊骨), Shudi, Maidong, Guishen, Duchong (Eucommia, 杜沖), Xianglian, calcined Muli.

Grind to powder, and use Chuan Shihu decocted in water to spread over and make pills.

Internal injury together with heat depression of the Shaoyang (少陽), nosebleed and loose stools with blood — the yin and yang collaterals are both injured; one must conserve strength and regulate.

Shengdi tan (charred raw Rehmannia, 生地炭), Baishao, Muxiang, Miren, Zexie, stir-fried Danpi, Biejia, Shanyao, Mugua.

Middle deficiency with yin fire not submerging, the six pulses deep and weak without strength.

Yuan Shengdi, Danpi, Fuling, Qizi, Yuzhu, Shanyao, Zexie, Yurou (Cornus, 萸肉), Chuan Bai, Lugen.

The constitution is originally yin deficient, and recently there is cough with qi rebelling, spontaneous sweating and spleen diarrhea, the six pulses deficient and rapid without strength — the yang is originally greatly deficient. One should fill and absorb and warm and supplement, but one cannot promise no danger.

Zhi Mianqi 2 qian, stir-fried Shudi 4 qian, Qizi 2 qian, Fuling 2 qian, Bei Wuwei 2 qian, Chenxiang zhi 3 fen, Zhen Xidang 3 qian, Zhi Yuzhu 2 qian, Baishao 2 qian, Zaoren 3 qian, Gan Heche (dried placenta, 干河車) 1.5 qian.

Prolonged cough without stopping, much phlegm and sore throat, and wheezing with a soft pulse, without strength in movement — not only is the yin deficient but the middle qi is greatly deficient; none of these are auspicious signs.

Zhi Yuzhu 2 qian, Maidong 2 qian, Fushen 2 qian, Gan Qizi 2 qian, Renzhongbai 1 qian, Da Shudi 4 qian, Wuwei 3 fen, honey-fried, Jubai 1 qian, calcined Muli 3 qian.

Prolonged cough with middle deficiency, much phlegm and spleen diarrhea, the fluids failing to supply the lung, hoarse voice and sore throat — this is a serious condition. The time of recovery is not to be promised.

Zhi Yuzhu 2 qian, Bei Shashen 2 qian, sheng Miren 4 qian, Fuling 2 qian, Renzhongbai 1 qian, Huai Shanyao 2 qian, Chuan Baihe 3 qian, Bai Biandou (white hyacinth bean, 白扁豆) 2 qian, Juhong 1 qian, winter mulberry leaf 1 qian.

Qi deficiency with bone heat, the nutritive fluid becoming phlegm, the sinews and bones unable to stretch, so that there is swelling and ulceration with pus and water, hard to close the wound. This already belongs to deficiency and damage; only cultivating the root is appropriate.

Sheng Qi 1.5 qian, Shudi 4 qian, Wuwei, honey-fried, 3 fen, Qizi 2 qian, Wujiapi 1 qian, stir-fried Zaoren 3 qian, Guishen 2 qian, Shanyao 2 qian, Maidong 2 qian, Chuanduan 1.5 qian, fine Sangzhi 4 qian, wine-stir-fried.

The condition belongs to deficiency and damage; do not treat it as wind-damp. Treat by cultivating and supplementing from the spleen and kidney, to seek the primordial qi to flourish and the illness to retreat (and there is seminal emission).

Shudi, Huai Yao, Guishen, Gouji, Mugua, Yuzhu, Qizi, Chuanduan, Duzhong, Yangshen (sheep kidney, 羊腎).

Paste-nourishing formula (膏滋方): remove Shanyao, Chuanduan, and Yangshen; add Sangzhi, Hutao, Dangshen, Hugu, Guiban, Bai Mi (white honey, 白蜜), and Xianglian fen (lotus seed powder, 湘蓮粉) to incorporate.

Middle deficiency with yin fire not submerging, much phlegm and internal heat — the root sprout of a consumptive (勞怯) condition; one must conserve strength and take medicine.

Zhi Shouwu 3 qian, Bei Shashen 2 qian, Nüzhen 2 qian, Juhong 1 qian, Zhi Xiangfu 3 qian, sheng Mianqi 1.5 qian, Guishen 1.5 qian, Duzhong 3 qian, Danpi 1.5 qian, winter mulberry leaf 1 qian.
translator_notes: 類瘧 (lei nue) rendered as 'malaria-like' to preserve the classical sense without equating to a modern diagnosis.
